falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_frontage_setback_figures.py && cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/frontage-setback-figures.test.ts __tests__/components/dcp-frontage-figure-notice.test.tsx
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a figure from another precinct or council is shown, a chapter whose PDF changed still contributes, a prose mention without a colon is taken as the caption, two captions on a page pick one, or the notice renders with no items
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Not mutation-tested. By reading: dropping the r2_path equality fails the stale-PDF test; dropping the colon from the caption pattern fails the prose-mention test in test_frontage_setback_figures.py.

pre_impl.existing_data: data/not_a_rule_krg_map_legend_2026-10-17.json (87 withheld legend rows), dcp_chapter_registry, DcpNotCoveredNotice pattern, meta.not_covered
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: 11 figure pages carry no single 'Figure N:' caption (e.g. 14E p7 prints 'Figure 1E.4-1', a typo, and only a prose mention); those say 'see page P' instead of naming a figure

functions.name: frontageSetbackFigures
functions.input: figure data, the address council, its precinct ids, current chapter PDF paths and chapters of those precincts
functions.output: figures to show, deduped and sorted
functions.if_none: no council match or no current PDF match -> []

functions.name: frontageSetbackNote
functions.input: the list of figure items selected for one address
functions.output: one sentence naming each figure and page

functions.name: pick_caption
functions.input: the plain text of one figure page of the chapter PDF
functions.output: the figure id when exactly one 'Figure N:' caption is printed
functions.if_none: None for zero or several captions

queries.purpose: current chapter PDF paths for the figure data
queries.where_clause: is_active AND council = $1 AND chapter_key = ANY($2)
queries.if_zero: no chapter matches its recorded PDF -> no notice
queries.if_wrong: a changed PDF never matches the recorded r2_path, so nothing is shown

queries.where_clause: source_council = $1 AND is_current AND v2_precinct_id = ANY($2)
queries.if_zero: centre-wide (null precinct) figures are not shown
queries.if_wrong: only figures of chapters that hold the address's own precincts can appear

break_it.scenario: the council republishes a centre chapter and the figure pages move
break_it.what_happens: the chapter's current PDF path differs from the recorded one and its figures are not shown

break_it.scenario: a page mentions a figure in prose and prints no caption
break_it.what_happens: no figure name is invented; the notice says see page P
break_it.how: caption pattern needs the trailing colon and exactly one match

break_it.scenario: the chapters or current paths query fails at request time
break_it.what_happens: the page says the figures could not be loaded and the rules response is unchanged
break_it.how: loadFrontageSetbackFigures catches, reports to captureServerException and returns failed: true; the notice shows a could-not-load line
break_it.repro: jest: returns [] and does not throw when a lookup fails

break_it.scenario: an address carries only a sub-precinct id while some figures are keyed to the centre id (14B, 14E)
break_it.what_happens: the centre-level figures are shown too, because 14E covers 14E_L3
break_it.how: a figure keyed to P applies to ids equal to P or starting with P_ (pre-push cross-review 2026-10-17)
break_it.repro: jest: a figure keyed to the centre applies to an address in one of its sub-precincts

residual_risk: 11 figure pages have no single caption and are shown as page numbers. Cross-review (pre-push, gpt-5.6-sol), round 1, 3 findings, all ACCEPTED and fixed: centre-level figures missed for sub-precinct addresses; a failed lookup looked like no figures (now failed: true and a could-not-load line); a null PDF URL could make a null#page link (script aborts, selector skips the chapter).
